notes: Tasks specialist on the shared OS floor. Ordinary create uses create_task and writes immediately; edits use update_task (Confirm). Other chat workbench writes use clare_mutate and wait for Confirm. Paths are propose-action `tasks:task:<id>` / `tasks:project:<id>`. Work blocks/sessions use `tasks:work_block:*` / `tasks:work_session:*`. Life remember/track/research use propose-action.
